title: Static page, no toolchain
prompt: Create a single self-contained index.html file (inline CSS, no build step, no dependencies) for a conference schedule page. The heading reads "DevConf 2026". Show four sessions in a list; each has a time, a talk title, and a speaker name. Add a footer reading "See you in Berlin".

rubric.description: The page shows a real interface, not a blank page or an error.
At least four sessions are listed, each showing a time, a talk title, and a speaker name.
A footer reading "See you in Berlin" is visible.
The page is deliberately styled rather than raw unstyled HTML.

iterations.description: The canonical small visual edit, with no bundler in the loop.
iterations.check: (() => { const h = document.querySelector('h1,h2,header'); if (!h) return false; const m = getComputedStyle(h).color.match(/\d+/g); if (!m) return false; const [r,g,b] = m.map(Number); return b > 90 && b > r + 25 && b > g + 15; })()
